metadata.title: JupyDo builder: vendored bundles, builder source and JupyDo hub image
metadata.description: Everything JupyDo needs to build reproducible JupyterLab environments offline: the vendored bundles of the JupyDo builder (Python, R, RStudio Server, VS Code, desktop, Apptainer, IGV, kernel libraries, apt packages, base images; amd64 and arm64), the builder source, and the JupyDo hub image. JupyDo's first_start.sh downloads them from here and checks them against SHA256SUMS.
